name: spot-order-level-exit-timing-screen-v1
hypothesis: A repeatable, observable delay or adverse execution component in ordinary MARKET exits may explain material avoidable BTC exposure cost independent of SMA exit confirmation.
unit: unique sell order_id, with fills summed and allocations deduplicated by order_id
observability: decision action and price available at decision_ms; signal_ms is historical completed bar; fill and future price unavailable until later
attribution: join fill order_id to settled allocation; join decision by decision_ms, signal_ms, side and order quantity; preserve unmatched as unknown
classifications: information_exit if all sold sleeves had exit action at recorded decision; operational_delay if decision-to-fill exceeds documented normal market latency, with timestamp validity; model_execution if all adverse decision-to-fill difference is a fixed synthetic impact; unknown otherwise
controls: original strategy and BTC price over same exposure interval; matching BTC participation, original fees, market execution and manual session starts; extra exit and reentry turnover must be charged
falsify_before_account: reject if no independently repeating identified abnormal delay/adverse execution beyond deterministic model impact, if material difference lacks a causal pre-order predictor, or if effect cannot survive costs and matched exposure without extra risk
minimum_account_if_qualified: one fixed intervention and simple constant exposure control across early/late and multiple original start times, with wealth, path-tail drawdown, ES, turnover, participation, execution and complexity; no parameter search
scope: read-only development-history diagnostic; no new account, new source-profit claim, native observations or private exchange actions
